hypothesis.hypothesis: Increasing width to 256 improves precision and AUPRC (HDD-CAPACITY-01), while reducing depth to 1 prevents the overfitting/instability seen in deeper TCNs (Trial 4 vs Trial 0). Restoring replicas=3 stabilizes the variance observed in single-replica runs. This configuration aims to boost low-FAR recall by improving ranking quality without sacrificing runtime efficiency excessively.

hypothesis.hypothesis: HDD-ARCHITECTURE-01显示dual架构在precision和low-FAR recall上优于TCN，但recall下降导致ROS微降。结合HDD-CAPACITY-01中width=256对AUPRC和F1的全面提升，将dual架构扩展至width=256并固定depth=1（避免trial 23/27中depth=2可能带来的过拟合或优化困难），旨在通过更大的容量补偿dual架构的recall损失，同时保留其在低误报率下的精度优势，从而在不增加过多运行时间的前提下提升综合指标。
